subject: music-dance
general_outcomes: By the end of senior secondary school, the learner should be able to:
Apply relevant knowledge, skills, values and attitudes, to create, perform and analyse Music and dance.
Appreciate diverse local and global cultures through listening, analysis and performance of Music and Dance.
Perform Music and Dance from various cultures for self-and cultural expression, and preservation.
Use available technologies to enhance learning and develop creativity in Music and Dance.
Apply research and innovation skills in the sustainable utilization of locally available resources for Music and Dance creation, performance and appreciation.
Relate Music and Dance to other arts and non-art disciplines to make meaningful connections.
Promote cultural, national, moral and religious values through Music and Dance.
Develop responsive and responsible global citizenship through involvement in Music and Dance activities from diverse cultures.
Utilise individual potential in Music and Dance for leisure, self-fulfilment, further education and training, and career growth.
Address pertinent and contemporary issues in society through Music and Dance activities.

assessment_rubric.indicator: Ability to create works of Music and Dance: - 4-bar rhythms incorporating semiquavers - 4-bar rhythms incorporating triplets - Major scales - 8-bar melodies - Set melody to text - Second part to a melody - Props and costumes

assessment_rubric.below: Creates at most 2 work(s) of Music and Dance applying the provided guidelines.
